question: Per capita income represents the average __________ earned by a person in that country.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Income**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Per capita income** is a measure of the** average income earned** by an individual in a particular country.
 
• It is** calculated by dividing the total income of a country by its total population.**
 
• It is a useful indicator of a country's economic well-being and can be used to compare the standard of living across different countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Income**: This refers to the **money earned** by an individual or business from various sources such as wages, salaries, investments, and profits. 

 
 
• It is an important measure of economic activity and is used to **gauge the financial health** of individuals, businesses, and countries.
 
 
 
• **Loan**: This refers to the **amount of money borrowed** by an individual or business from a lender.
 
 
• It can be used for various purposes such as buying a house, starting a business, or financing education. Loans **come with interest rates and repayment terms** that need to be fulfilled by the borrower.
 
 
 
• **Capital**: This refers to the** assets owned** by a company or individual such as property, equipment, and investments.
 
 
• It is an important measure of wealth and is used to **determine the financial strength** of a company or individual.
 
 
 
• **Liability**: This refers to the **debts owed** by a company or individual such as loans, mortgages, and credit card balances.
 
 
• It is an important measure of financial obligations and is used to **determine the financial risk** associated with a company or individual.
